_note: gf-vista core sounds (research/gf-vista/kit/audio.js). The core's soundscape plays these files itself into the gf-audio kit's sfx bus; a game lists them in assets.json sounds so Studio shows them. kit/audio.js splitSounds() keeps them out of createAudio (it would decode every file again) and applies each one's gainDb. Files: CC0 field recordings, credits in core/public/audio/CREDITS.md.
